name: The Ballantyne
positioning: The Ballantyne, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Charlotte: a hotel with a spa, indoor and outdoor pools and a large backyard in the Ballantyne community of South Charlotte
best_for: Travelers who want spa time and pools without leaving Charlotte
Groups and families who want a four-bedroom cottage on the property

facts.text: The Ballantyne is set in the Ballantyne community of South Charlotte.
The Amp and The Bowl at Ballantyne are right at the hotel's doorstep.
Grand Deluxe rooms overlook the park.
Many of the hotel's suites have balconies with views of the park.
The spa offers massages, facials, body treatments, nail services and hair salon care.
The spa has an indoor pool, resistance pools and a whirlpool, fitness facilities, a eucalyptus steam room and sauna, a lounge, a boutique and dining.
The seasonal outdoor pool has a full pool bar and pool menu, and cabana rentals are available.
Hotel guests get complimentary cruiser bike rental, and the hotel offers transportation to the nearby Greenway trail.
Gallery Restaurant serves Southern American-inspired cuisine, and its dining room has paintings from Awaken Gallery.
Gallery Bar holds one of the largest whiskey collections in the Carolinas.
Dalmatian statues at the front entrance are a nod to the Bissell family dogs.
The hotel holds 4 Keys in the Green Key Global Eco-Rating Certification Program.

highlights.text: The Ballantyne has a Clefs d'Or-credentialed concierge.
The hotel has an indoor grotto-inspired pool for year-round swimming.
The hotel has a large backyard with Adirondack chairs and hammocks.
Rooms are dressed in Frette linens and designed with Hollywood Regency touches such as tufted headboards and brass accents.
The Cottage at Ballantyne is a four-bedroom residence on the property.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside the downtown Charlotte core.
The outdoor pool is seasonal; the indoor pool is the year-round option.
Rooms do not have a fridge or a coffee/tea maker.
